messages:
mara (Security): Auditor asked for a bundled evidence package: RBAC change approval, k8s audit events, Splunk exports, KMS rotation/decrypt events, and vuln triage artifacts for Feb 10-12 2026. Who can assemble?
jonathan (Infra): I can collect k8s audit logs and RoleBinding events. Will tar + gzip the raw jsons. Need exact timeframe and any PR IDs to include.
emily (DevEx): I can grab console screenshots and the approval ticket. Also will note which files need redaction.
mara (Security): Timeframe: 2026-02-10T00:00:00Z -> 2026-02-12T23:59:59Z. Include PR that approved the change: #3498 and the canary rollout snippet.
auditor: Please include chain-of-custody manifest and checksums. Also we need the Splunk query and raw output for correlation.
auditor-bot: Reminder: manifest format expected: `filename,size,md5,uploaded_by,timestamp`.
jonathan (Infra): Splunk query I used: `index=k8s_audit action=RoleBinding OR action=ClusterRoleBinding | sort _time | table _time,user,verb,objectRef,namespace` — will include raw results + a grepped snapshot.
oliver (SRE): Tagging for KMS events — I can pull CloudTrail filtered for `RotateKey`, `CreateKey`, `UpdateKeyDescription`, `GenerateDataKey`, `Decrypt`. Will provide CSV: eventTime,eventName,userIdentity,requestParameters.keyId,awsRegion. Note: some events in eu-west-1; will include region mapping.
mara (Security): Also include incident triage for CVE-2025-0555 that prompted the RBAC change. Need timeline, decision notes, and mitigation steps.
ben (Oncall): Linked runbook + triage notes: https://notion.redwood/incident/CVE-2025-0555 — exporting to PDF now. Playbook snippet we ran: `oncall run vuln-triage --id CVE-2025-0555`.
auditor: Can you confirm if any service-account secrets or emergency KMS keys were created during mitigation? We need proof of rotation.
mara (Security): Service accounts were rotated (see PR #3502). Emergency key generation logged in `key_rotation.log`. I'll attach signed approval email thread for emergency use.
jonathan (Infra): Uploading package now. S3 path: `s3://redwood-compliance/audits/2026-02-rbac-kms/6319001234_evidence.tar.gz` — presigned URL (7d): https://s3-presigned.example/REDACTED (will send via secure channel). Manifest attached in the bundle. MD5: `abc123def4567890`.
auditor-bot: Received package notification. Please ensure the bundle includes a manifest and chain-of-custody. If you need to encrypt the bundle with customer-managed key use SSE-KMS and include the key alias.
emily (DevEx): We used SSE-KMS with key alias `alias/compliance-archive`. Marked files that contain potential PII; redaction metadata included as `redaction_index.csv`.
auditor: One more thing — provide log retention policy reference and config proving logs are retained per SOC 2 requirement (min 6 months).
mara (Security): Retention policy doc exported: `docs/security/log-retention.md` (included). Logs for this timeframe are on S3 with lifecycle: 1 year retention, transition to Glacier at 90 days.
johnathan (Infra): FYI — Splunk export note: we sampled by `eventCount=1000` for the quick export, but raw events are in the tarball.
emily (DevEx): Packaging checklist done ✅ PR: #3510 with packaging steps and reviewer signoff.
auditor: We'll review the bundle and get back with any clarifying asks. If we request redaction, we will specify fields.
mara (Security): Thanks — I'll send auditor the presigned link + manifest and keep this thread for follow-ups. If they request further separation (e.g., provide KMS logs without user email addresses), tell us and we'll produce a redacted repackage.
